newsitem.title: USA: Class action suit filed vs Dean Witter Reynolds.
newsitem.headline: Class action suit filed vs Dean Witter Reynolds.

text.p: The law firm John Lawrence Allen said on Monday it and the firm Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach filed a $300 million lawsuit against Dean Witter Reynolds Inc in California's Superior Court.

The suit charges Dean Witter and the other defendants with selling their clients very high-risk "managed futures" funds on the false premise that such funds reduce volatility and risk while generating high returns.
The suit also names 10 of Dean Witter's managed futures limited partnerships, Demeter Management Corp, a Dean Witter subsidiary, and two trading advisers, John Allen said.
Officials at Dean Witter Reynolds, a unit of Dean Witter, Discover & Co, were not immediately available for comment.

According to a statement issued by LVM Group, a public relations firm representing John Allen, the suit follows a decision last May by an arbitration panel to approve a punitive damage award in a complaint against Dean Witter involving managed futures.
The three complainants in that case were represented by the Allen firm, the release said.
The suit seeks restoration of lost capital and unspecified damages.
